cards.front: Which muscle elevates the eye when it is adducted? [___]
cards.context: The inferior oblique is supplied by cranial nerve III. It elevates an adducted eye and also contributes to extorsion.

cards.front: In the cavernous sinus, the abducens nerve lies immediately beside the internal [___] artery.
cards.context:
Within the cavernous sinus, the sixth nerve runs beside the internal carotid artery rather than in the lateral dural wall.

A cavernous-sinus process can therefore produce sixth-nerve palsy with other ocular motor or trigeminal findings.
